title: Can EmeraldLED Reshape Your Body With Continued Use?
official: Can EmeraldLED Reshape Your Body With Continued Use?
summary: Already using EmeraldLED? TheGreen Light Therapy study explores how continuing participants' 15-minute sessions, twice a week, may continue to support positive changes in body composition.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Can read and understand English.
* US resident.
* Willing and able to follow the requirements of the protocol.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals with eye conditions
* Individuals not active with EmeraldLED
